adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Airmail shows more of the user's inbox and messages at once, without toggling back and forth.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Airmail 能同时显示更多的收件箱内容和邮件，无需来回切换。
highlights: More of the inbox and messages visible at once
Named by Apple among Duo-optimized apps in Europe
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Apple named American Airlines among the apps adapted for iPhone Duo, saying it places boarding passes, seat selection, and terminal maps within easy reach. No specific two-pane layout was described.
adaptation_zh: Apple 将美国航空列入为 iPhone Duo 适配的应用，称其将登机牌、选座和航站楼地图放在触手可及的位置。官方未描述具体的双栏布局。
highlights: Boarding passes, seat selection and terminal maps within easy reach
Named by Apple as adapted for iPhone Duo
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: Races fill the large inner display, with detailed cars and dynamic lighting putting more of the track in front of players. Gameloft's game manager credited the inner display and A20 Pro's sustained performance for showing more track and car detail.
adaptation_zh: 竞速画面铺满较大的内屏，细致的车辆与动态光影让玩家看到更多赛道。Gameloft 游戏经理表示，内屏与 A20 Pro 的持续性能让更多赛道和车辆细节得以呈现。
highlights: More than 350 cars
Races against up to seven online opponents
App Store notes v53.5.4 on 2026-10-23: 'now optimized for iPhone Duo'
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Version 3.0.2 release notes state 'Bear is now ready for iPhone Duo', shipped alongside a fresh new design for panels; Fits Duo reports Bear fills the inner display with a panel layout and adapts when you fold.
adaptation_zh: 3.0.2 版更新说明写「Bear is now ready for iPhone Duo」，同版带来全新的面板设计；据 Fits Duo，Bear 以面板布局铺满内屏，并随折叠自适应
highlights: App Store v3.0.2: 'Bear is now ready for iPhone Duo!'
Same release: fresh new design for panels
Fits Duo: fills the inner display, panel layout, adapts when you fold
source_name: Bear - Markdown Notes, App Store (Version 3.0.2 release notes)

adaptation_en: Callsheet's version 2026.8 release notes add support for the iPhone Duo and multiple instance support for iPad and iPhone Duo, so users can open more than one Callsheet window and they will operate independently.
adaptation_zh: Callsheet 版本 2026.8 的更新说明增加了对 iPhone Duo 的支持，以及对 iPad 和 iPhone Duo 的多实例支持，用户可以打开多个 Callsheet 窗口且各自独立运行。
highlights: Support for iPhone Duo (v2026.8, Oct 16)
Multiple independent Callsheet windows on Duo
source_name: App Store: Callsheet: Find Cast & Crew — Version 2026.8 release notes
CapWords: AI Language Tutor - App Store (US)

highlights: Listed in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection (US story)
source_name: App Store — Great Apps on iPhone Duo (US)

adaptation_en: Craft is fully optimized for iPhone Duo from day one, offering more room across notes, tasks and documents, with a style gallery and live preview appearing side by side when the device unfolds.
adaptation_zh: Craft 从首发日起就为 iPhone Duo 做了完整优化，展开后为笔记、任务和文档提供更大空间，样式库与实时预览可并排显示。
highlights: Ready for iPhone Duo from day one
Style gallery and live preview side by side when unfolded
Adapts between compact and unfolded poses (9to5Mac)
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

highlights: Featured in App Store 'Great Games on iPhone Duo' collection as 'Endless Arcade Hopper'
source_name: App Store: Great Games on iPhone Duo

highlights: Apple Arcade title featured in App Store 'Great Games on iPhone Duo' collection
Described in collection as 'Endless Co-op Platform Fun'
source_name: App Store: Great Games on iPhone Duo
App Store: Great Apps on iPhone Duo collection

adaptation_en: Fits Duo reports Crunchyroll fills the inner display and adapts when you fold; version 4.122.0 is built with the iOS 27.1 SDK and uses Apple's iPhone Duo APIs (including hinge interaction and arrangement APIs). No specific two-pane layout is documented, so the score stays at the default.
adaptation_zh: 据 Fits Duo，Crunchyroll 铺满内屏并随折叠自适应；4.122.0 版基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 构建，并使用了苹果的 iPhone Duo API（含铰链交互与排布 API）。暂无具体双栏布局记录，评分保持默认
highlights: Listed in App Store 'Great apps and games on iPhone Duo' collection
Fits Duo: fills the inner display, uses iPhone Duo APIs (v4.122.0, iOS 27.1 SDK)
source_name: Fits Duo - Does Crunchyroll fit iPhone Duo?
App Store: Great apps on iPhone Duo collection

adaptation_en: Deck-Man turns iPhone Duo into a retro cassette player: users open it to pick an album and insert the tape, then close it to start listening to music from Apple Music. TechCrunch adds that when open the cassette appears to play on one side beside album imagery, and when closed the interface looks like the front of a Walkman.
adaptation_zh: Deck-Man 把 iPhone Duo 变成复古磁带播放器：用户打开手机挑选专辑、插入磁带，然后合上手机开始聆听 Apple Music 的音乐。TechCrunch 补充说，打开时磁带在一侧播放、旁边是专辑图，合上时界面看起来像 Walkman 的正面。
highlights: Open to select album and insert tape, close to play
Works with Apple Music
By indie developer Vidit Bhargava; launched 2026-10-23
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Detail puts video and its transcript side by side on the inner display, which its founder says is how creators want to edit podcasts and interviews. It also uses Apple's new Core AI framework to run AI models on device for captions, filler-word removal and audio enhancement.
adaptation_zh: Detail 在内屏上将视频与其文字稿并排显示，其创始人称这正是创作者编辑播客和访谈想要的方式。它还使用苹果新的 Core AI 框架在设备端运行 AI 模型，实现字幕、口头禅词去除和音频增强。
highlights: Video and transcript side by side
Uses Core AI framework to run AI models on device
Founder quote from Paul Veugen in Apple Newsroom
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, edjing Mix gives DJs more room for two decks, audio effects, and one-tap stem separation. Opened, the larger inner display brings the decks, mixer, and music library together, while closed it offers a compact mixing experience.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，edjing Mix 为 DJ 提供了更宽敞的空间来容纳双唱盘、音效和一键人声/伴奏分离。展开后，更大的内屏将唱盘、混音台和音乐库汇集在一起；合盖时则提供紧凑的混音体验。
highlights: Two decks with more room on inner display
Decks, mixer and library together when open
source_name: Apple Newsroom - Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

highlights: Featured in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection as 'Plant-Based & Easy Cooking'
source_name: App Store: Great Apps on iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Essayist can be written in on the closed display or unfolded for the full page. Half open, the essay sits on one half and the inspector on the other.
adaptation_zh: Essayist 可在合盖显示屏上写作，也可展开查看整页。半开时，文章位于一侧，检查器位于另一侧。
highlights: Half-open essay / inspector split
Write closed or unfold for full page
source_name: Essayist: Academic Writing App - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: Fantastical shows calendars, tasks and menus together on the larger inner display, so users can take in more of their schedule at a glance — described by Flexibits as the full Fantastical experience from Mac and iPad in your pocket.
adaptation_zh: Fantastical 在更大的内屏上同时显示日历、任务和菜单，用户可一眼看清更多日程；Flexibits 称其为装进口袋的完整 Mac/iPad 版 Fantastical 体验。
highlights: Calendars, tasks and menus visible together on inner display
Duo support added in version 4.2.3 (App Store notes: 'Added support for iPhone Duo')
Split View use with Cardhop cited by Flexibits CEO
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Finalist 4.2 adds full iPhone Duo support with a layout for every pose: opened like a book, Agenda and Timeline sit side by side on two pages; the Planner remembers a layout per pose; and propped half-open like a laptop, the top half becomes a Desk Clock counting down the agenda.
adaptation_zh: Finalist 4.2 完整支持 iPhone Duo，为每种姿态都准备了布局：像书一样打开时，Agenda 与 Timeline 分列两页并排显示；Planner 会记住每种姿态的布局；半开如笔记本电脑支起时，上半屏变为显示日程倒计时的 Desk Clock。
highlights: Two-page layouts: Agenda on one page, Timeline on the other
Per-pose layouts are saved as Layout destinations
New Weekly Timeline and Day Review split across both halves; half-open Desk Clock pose
source_name: Finalist developer blog: Ready for iPhone Duo (Finalist 4.2)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Flighty spreads its map to the edges of the open display with flight details on the left and more room for the globe, and adds En Route Mode — a dedicated flight-tracking mode for when the Duo is propped up in tent mode on a tray table.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Flighty 将地图铺满展开的屏幕边缘，航班详情移至左侧，为地球视图留出更多空间；并新增 En Route Mode——将 Duo 以帐篷模式支在小桌板上时专用的航班跟踪模式。
highlights: En Route Mode for tent/propped use
Map spreads to the edges, flight details on the left
Works in split screen
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: Built for Duo: opening and closing the device works as the power switch, the cover screen shows the viewfinder preview and REC light, and closing the device saves the clip.
adaptation_zh: Duo 专属设计：开合即电源开关，外屏取景预览 + REC 灯，合上即保存
highlights: App Store product page has a 'Built for iPhone Duo' section
Featured by 9to5Mac as a Duo-optimized app (2026-10-24)
Opening/closing the fold acts as the power switch
Cover screen shows the subject a viewfinder preview in the same retro look, with a REC light
Closing the device mid-flip saves the clip to today's tape
source_name: Flipcorder: Retro Camcorder - App Store

adaptation_en: FotMob is ready for iPhone Duo: unfolded, it keeps your list on one side and the match, league, team or player you picked on the other.
adaptation_zh: FotMob 已适配 iPhone Duo：展开后，一侧保留列表，另一侧显示所选的比赛、联赛、球队或球员。
highlights: Two-pane layout: list on one side, selection on the other
Live scores, match stats and news for 400+ competitions
source_name: FotMob - Soccer Live Scores — App Store (US)

highlights: Listed in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection (US story)
source_name: App Store — Great Apps on iPhone Duo (US)

adaptation_en: Unfolded, the whole hole fills the big screen. Folded like a laptop, you putt on the half resting on the table while the upright half becomes a caddie camera looking down the hole.
adaptation_zh: 展开后，整个球洞铺满大屏；像笔记本一样半折时，在平放的一半上推杆，直立的一半则变成俯瞰球洞的球童视角。
highlights: Full hole fills the inner screen when unfolded
Laptop pose: caddie camera on upright half
Closed: play continues on the outer screen (developer site)
source_name: Greens: Mini-golf — App Store (US)
Great apps on iPhone Duo — App Store story (US)

adaptation_en: Instagram shows more posts and Stories onscreen at once on iPhone Duo's larger inner display.
adaptation_zh: Instagram 在 iPhone Duo 更大的内屏上可同时显示更多帖子和快拍。
highlights: More posts and Stories onscreen at once
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: With Edits on iPhone Duo, creators can view their full creative studio at once, including timeline, editing tools, video, and more.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上使用 Edits，创作者可同时查看完整的创作工作室，包括时间线、编辑工具、视频等。
highlights: Timeline, editing tools and video shown together
Full creative studio view on inner display
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)
DuoReady directory

adaptation_en: Apple named Lowe's among the apps adapted for iPhone Duo, saying it lets home improvement shoppers take a closer look at finishes, materials, and design details. No specific layout arrangement was described.
adaptation_zh: Apple 将 Lowe's 列入为 iPhone Duo 适配的应用，称其让家装购物者可以更仔细地查看饰面、材料和设计细节。官方未描述具体的布局方式。
highlights: Closer look at finishes, materials and design details
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, LTK lets shoppers watch creators' videos and browse the exact products featured in the same view.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，LTK 让购物者可以在同一视图中观看创作者视频并浏览视频中出现的同款产品。
highlights: Creator videos and featured products in the same view
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Lyft gives riders more room to compare ride options and see the route at the same time, with ride options beside a larger route map.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Lyft 让乘客有更多空间同时比较乘车选项和查看路线，乘车选项位于更大的路线地图旁。
highlights: Ride options beside a larger route map
Compare ride options and route at the same time
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: MD Vinyl arrives on iPhone Duo with a 3D album collection you flip through in a vinyl layout that responds as you fold the screen. Set the Duo half-open on a desk and it becomes a small record player, with album art above the spinning vinyl.
adaptation_zh: MD Vinyl 登陆 iPhone Duo，带来可 3D 翻阅的专辑收藏，其唱片布局会随折叠屏幕而响应。将 Duo 半开放在桌面上，它就变成一台小唱机，专辑封面位于旋转的黑胶唱片上方。
highlights: Half-open desk record-player mode
3D album browsing responds to folding
Album art above spinning vinyl
source_name: MD Vinyl Music App - App Store (US)

highlights: Listed in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection
source_name: App Store — Great Apps on iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Set partially folded on a table, MLB plays the live game on the upright half while real-time stats fill the half resting on the table. It also shows live games, scores and stats across the full width of the inner display.
adaptation_zh: 半折放在桌上时，MLB 在直立的一半播放直播比赛，实时数据填满平放的一半；展开时，直播、比分和数据铺满内屏全宽。
highlights: Seated pose: game upright, stats below
Ready for the World Series (MLB EVP Kenny Gersh, via Apple)
Press demo also showed multi-view / different streams per display (Sports Business Journal)
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Mockup 4.6 brings an adaptive workspace to iPhone Duo, with layouts made for Duo's outer and inner displays and support for tabletop use. Users can browse projects and sketch with more room when unfolded, alongside refined canvas controls.
adaptation_zh: Mockup 4.6 为 iPhone Duo 带来自适应工作区，布局专为 Duo 的外屏和内屏设计，并支持桌面（tabletop）使用。用户展开后可获得更多空间浏览项目和绘图，同时画布控件也得到优化。
highlights: Adaptive workspace for outer and inner displays (v4.6)
Tabletop use support
Refined canvas controls
source_name: App Store: Mockup - UI/UX Design — Version 4.6 release notes
Great Apps on iPhone Duo — App Store story (US)

adaptation_en: Users can scroll through Clips on the outer display and then open the Duo to keep watching on the large inner display, with Clips switching seamlessly between vertical and horizontal views. Netflix's October 26 update also reimagines playback controls to adapt to full-screen, book, tent and tabletop poses.
adaptation_zh: 用户可在外屏刷 Clips 短视频，展开 Duo 后在大尺寸内屏继续观看，Clips 可在竖屏与横屏视图间无缝切换。Netflix 10月26日的更新还重塑了播放控件，使其能适配全屏、书本、帐篷和桌面等姿态。
highlights: Clips on outer display, continued on inner display
Playback controls adapt to full-screen, book, tent and tabletop poses
Controls feature a reflective glow that responds to the hinge angle (Netflix update, Oct 26, 2026)
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Night Sky 27.1 adds full iPhone Duo support and optimization, including a new Aura Tonight tour layout designed specifically for iPhone Duo in the seated position.
adaptation_zh: Night Sky 27.1 加入了对 iPhone Duo 的完整支持与优化，包括专为 iPhone Duo 坐姿模式设计的全新 Aura Tonight 导览布局。
highlights: Full iPhone Duo support in v27.1 (Oct 13)
Aura Tonight tour layout for seated position
source_name: Night Sky - App Store (US)

highlights: Described by MacRumors as an anti-gravity racing game with neon colors that looks great on iPhone Duo
source_name: MacRumors — The iPhone Duo Can Be a Tiny Mac, a Toaster, and a Nintendo DS (2026-10-23)

Listed in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection
source_name: (Not Boring) Camera — App Store product page, version 1.62

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Notewise brings notes, documents and AI tools together in a single view on the larger display.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Notewise 将笔记、文档和 AI 工具汇聚到更大的屏幕上的单一视图中同时呈现。
highlights: Notes, documents and AI tools in a single view
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: When iPhone Duo is partially folded and placed on a counter, NYT Cooking shows more detailed recipes with richer visuals, making it easy to follow along while cooking. Propped on the counter, users can follow each step, set timers, and watch recipe creators demonstrate techniques with more room.
adaptation_zh: 当 iPhone Duo 半折放在台面上时，NYT Cooking 会显示更详细的食谱和更丰富的视觉内容，方便烹饪时跟随操作。支在台面上，用户可以跟随每个步骤、设置计时器，并以更宽敞的空间观看食谱创作者演示技巧。
highlights: Partially folded counter mode
More detailed recipes with richer visuals
Follow steps, timers and creator videos propped up
source_name: Apple Newsroom - Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Apple said OpenTable adapts its layout on iPhone Duo, keeping restaurant details, availability, and booking easy to navigate. No specific pane arrangement was described.
adaptation_zh: Apple 表示 OpenTable 在 iPhone Duo 上适配了布局，让餐厅详情、可用时间和预订更易于浏览。官方未描述具体的分栏方式。
highlights: Adapted layout for restaurant details, availability and booking
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: Designed for iPhone Duo, where physically folding the phone is the move: folding lands the left page onto the paper maze, bridging holes and pinning characters underneath, and the folded maze carries on, combined, on the cover screen. On other iPhones and iPad the two pages sit side by side and folding is done with a tap or pinch.
adaptation_zh: 专为 iPhone Duo 设计，实际折叠手机就是操作本身：折叠时左页会落到纸质迷宫上， 填补洞口并压住下方的角色，折叠后的迷宫会合并显示在外屏上继续进行。在其他 iPhone 和 iPad 上，两页并排显示，用点按或捏合来折叠。
highlights: 69 levels in six paper-themed worlds
$4.99, no ads or in-app purchases
Folding bridges gaps, pins characters, and carries characters on unfold
source_name: Orisuji - App Store
Great Apps on iPhone Duo - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: Paramount+ offers richer playback controls and expanded browsing for shows and live channels on iPhone Duo, using the larger canvas for movies and series.
adaptation_zh: Paramount+ 在 iPhone Duo 上提供更丰富的播放控件，以及更宽广的剧集和直播频道浏览空间，并利用更大的画布呈现电影和剧集。
highlights: Richer playback controls
Expanded browsing for shows and live channels
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Penbook opens into a two-page spread on iPhone Duo, and its 8.1.1 update adds support for Duo poses, new stationery sizes and a minimap update.
adaptation_zh: Penbook 在 iPhone Duo 上展开为双页摊开式布局，其 8.1.1 更新加入了对 Duo 各种姿态的支持、新的纸张尺寸以及小地图更新。
highlights: Opens into a two-page spread on the Duo
Version 8.1.1 (Oct 16, 2026): support for poses, new stationery sizes, minimap update
source_name: Penbook: Paper Planner & Notes, App Store (Version 8.1.1 release notes)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, PGA Tour presents live games and highlights with real-time scores, stats and leaderboards on the larger display.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，PGA Tour 在更大的屏幕上呈现直播和集锦，以及实时比分、数据和排行榜。
highlights: Live coverage and highlights on the larger display
Real-time scores, stats and leaderboards
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Publisher Playdigious confirmed Planet of Lana is fully compatible with iPhone Duo's dual-screen, folding design, with a revamped and optimised interface specifically for the Duo. No specific split or cover-screen layout was described.
adaptation_zh: 发行商 Playdigious 确认《Planet of Lana》完全兼容 iPhone Duo 的双屏折叠设计，并配有专为 Duo 重新优化的界面。未公布具体的分屏或外屏布局细节。
highlights: One of five Playdigious games announced as fully iPhone Duo compatible on 2026-10-23
Revamped and optimised interface for the Duo's dual-screen design
source_name: Pocket Gamer: Playdigious announces iPhone Duo compatible games, including Subnautica and Planet of Lana
Great Apps on iPhone Duo - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: Portal's nature scenes fill the entire display when iPhone Duo is unfolded and work especially well in tent mode. In laptop pose, horizons and waterlines can fall along the fold, and propped in tent/standing pose it supports its Sleep Timer and Wake Up Alarm.
adaptation_zh: Portal 的自然场景在 iPhone Duo 展开时可铺满整个显示屏，在帐篷模式下效果尤佳。在笔记本姿态下，地平线和水线可沿折痕落位；以帐篷/站立姿态支起时，可配合其睡眠定时器和唤醒闹钟使用。
highlights: Full-display scenes when unfolded
Tent mode for sleep/wake
Horizon/waterline aligned to the fold in laptop pose
source_name: Portal for iPhone Duo: Unfold New Horizons - Portal (developer press)

adaptation_en: When partially folded, Prime Video plays content on the top half of the display while X-Ray details showing cast and bonus content appear on the bottom half. It also uses the larger canvas for movies and series and can be propped up for hands-free viewing.
adaptation_zh: 半折叠时，Prime Video 在屏幕上半部分播放内容，下半部分显示 X-Ray 演员详情和花絮内容。它还利用更大的画布呈现电影和剧集，并可支起设备免手持观看。
highlights: Video on top half, X-Ray cast/bonus details on bottom half when partially folded
Uses larger canvas for movies and series
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)
Great Apps on iPhone Duo - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: Version 2026.11.1 adds 'Initial support for iPhone Duo' per its App Store release notes; the same release makes Reeder use a vertical bar in landscape on all iPhones. Support is explicitly described as initial, hence the transitional score.

highlights: App Store version 2026.11.1 notes: 'Initial support for iPhone Duo'
Listed in App Store 'Great Apps on iPhone Duo' collection (US story)
source_name: Reeder — App Store product page, version 2026.11.1 release notes

adaptation_en: On Apple Arcade, Retrocade takes full advantage of the folding display, delivering a uniquely immersive experience when opened and convenient pick-up-and-play fun when closed. Its App Store page states it 'now supports the different ways to play on iPhone Duo.'
adaptation_zh: 在 Apple Arcade 上，Retrocade 充分利用折叠屏，打开时带来独特沉浸的体验，合上时则方便随手即玩。其 App Store 页面称它“现已支持在 iPhone Duo 上的不同游玩方式”。
highlights: Apple Arcade title named by Apple as adapted for the folding display
Immersive when open, pick-up-and-play when closed
source_name: Retrocade - App Store

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Salesforce helps teams manage customer relationships and act on business insights, with more of their dashboards in view.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Salesforce 帮助团队管理客户关系并根据业务洞察采取行动，同时能看到更多的仪表盘内容。
highlights: More dashboards in view for CRM and business insights
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

highlights: Version 1.20: 'Beautiful new parks and wildlife layouts for iPhone Duo and iPad'
source_name: Scratchbook: National Parks, App Store (Version 1.20 release notes)

adaptation_en: Sequel feels at home on iPhone Duo: opening it up gives every title a new immersive layout designed for the inner display, and the library uses the extra room to switch between media types with ease. Screens make room for the vertical bar and adapt as you open and close the Duo.
adaptation_zh: Sequel 在 iPhone Duo 上得心应手：展开后，每个条目都会获得专为内屏设计的沉浸式新布局，媒体库也能利用额外空间轻松切换媒体类型。各界面会为竖向栏留出空间，并随 Duo 的开合而适配。
highlights: Immersive inner-display layout for every title
Library uses extra room to switch media types
Adapts to vertical bar on open/close
source_name: Sequel • Media Tracker - App Store

adaptation_en: Apple said Shop shows more products in its feed on iPhone Duo, with more room to discover, buy, and track orders, in every pose. No specific two-pane layout was described.
adaptation_zh: Apple 表示 Shop 在 iPhone Duo 上会在信息流中显示更多产品，并有更多空间用于发现、购买和跟踪订单，且适用于各种姿势。官方未描述具体的双栏布局。
highlights: More products in the feed
More room to discover, buy and track orders in every pose
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: Sky Guide is optimized for iPhone Duo, expanding as you unfold the display for a broader, more immersive view, with edge-to-edge star maps paired with Liquid Glass controls across the inner display.
adaptation_zh: Sky Guide 已针对 iPhone Duo 优化，展开显示屏时可扩展为更宽广、更沉浸的视图，内屏上呈现边缘到边缘的星图并搭配 Liquid Glass 控件。
highlights: Edge-to-edge star maps on inner display
Expands on unfold (v13.1)
source_name: Sky Guide - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Slack brings the user's whole workspace into view, making it easy to follow channels and threads at a glance on the larger inner display.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Slack 将用户的整个工作区呈现在更大的内屏上，可一眼跟进频道和话题串。
highlights: Whole workspace in view; channels and threads at a glance
Multi-column / full inner display layout reported for v26.10.30
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Slopes is optimized for iPhone Duo: folded it uses a compact interface with a smaller map, and opened it takes advantage of much larger full-screen maps.
adaptation_zh: Slopes 已针对 iPhone Duo 优化：折叠时使用带较小地图的紧凑界面，展开后则使用大得多的全屏地图。
highlights: Compact folded interface with smaller map
Much larger full-screen maps when open
source_name: Slopes — What's New iOS (developer site), v2026.16, 2026-10-09

adaptation_en: SmartGym 8.1 is ready for iPhone Duo with layouts for every pose — Closed, Book Style, Fully Opened, Seated and Tent. In Book Style the routine sits on one page and the selected exercise on the other, and in Seated pose the bottom half becomes a live dashboard with heart-rate chart, calories, zones and workout controls.
adaptation_zh: SmartGym 8.1 已适配 iPhone Duo，为每种姿态都设计了布局——合上、书本式、完全展开、坐姿和帐篷式。书本式下，一页显示训练计划、另一页显示所选动作；坐姿时，下半屏变成实时仪表盘，显示心率图、卡路里、心率区间和训练控制。
highlights: Layouts for Closed, Book Style, Fully Opened, Seated and Tent poses
Book Style: routine and exercise side by side
Seated pose: bottom half is a live workout dashboard
source_name: SmartGym: Gym & Home Workouts — App Store (US), version 8.1

adaptation_en: On Apple Arcade, Sneaky Sasquatch takes full advantage of the folding display, delivering a uniquely immersive experience when opened and convenient pick-up-and-play fun when closed.
adaptation_zh: 在 Apple Arcade 上，Sneaky Sasquatch 充分利用折叠屏，打开时带来独特沉浸的体验，合上时则方便随手即玩。
highlights: Apple Arcade title named by Apple as adapted for the folding display
Immersive when open, pick-up-and-play when closed
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Unfold Sofa on iPhone Duo and you get a two-column layout split at the fold, with your lists on one side and what you're looking at on the other, resizing cleanly as you open, close and rotate. The podcast player also splits across the fold, with the transcript on the upright half in laptop/seated pose.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上展开 Sofa，会获得以折痕分隔的双栏布局：一侧是你的列表，另一侧是正在查看的内容，并可随开合和旋转干净地调整大小。播客播放器也会跨折痕分隔，在笔记本/坐姿下字幕稿位于直立的上半部分。
highlights: Two-column layout split at the fold
Podcast player splits across fold
Transcript on upright half in seated pose
source_name: Sofa's Podcast Player Got a Glow-Up - Sofa (developer blog, Sofa 5.4)

highlights: Version 3.3 (Oct 8) release notes state it has been optimised for iPhone Duo and that saved locations can now be reordered by dragging
source_name: Solstice — App Store (US), version 3.3, Oct 8

adaptation_en: Fits Duo reports Strava fills the inner display and adapts when you fold; its current version (487.0.0) is built with the iOS 27.1 SDK but uses none of Apple's iPhone Duo APIs, so the adaptation is a basic full-screen fill rather than a Duo-specific layout.
adaptation_zh: 据 Fits Duo，Strava 铺满内屏并随折叠自适应；当前版本（487.0.0）基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 构建，但未使用苹果的 iPhone Duo 专用 API，属基础铺满而非 Duo 专属布局
highlights: Fits Duo: fills the inner display, adapts when you fold (v487.0.0, iOS 27.1 SDK, no Duo APIs used)
source_name: Fits Duo - Does Strava fit iPhone Duo?

adaptation_en: The Tesla app uses a tablet-style two-column layout on iPhone Duo's inner display, with navigation and controls on the left and a larger vehicle or home energy visualization on the right. Folded closed, the outer screen returns to the familiar phone layout.
adaptation_zh: Tesla 应用在 iPhone Duo 内屏上采用平板式双栏布局，左侧是导航和控件，右侧是更大的车辆或家庭能源可视化界面。折合后，外屏恢复为熟悉的手机布局。
highlights: Two-column layout: controls left, visualization right
Charging, Live Camera and dashcam clips alongside vehicle view
Outer screen keeps phone layout
source_name: Tesla App Gains iPad and iPhone Duo Support - MacRumors

adaptation_en: Things 3.25 reshapes itself for every iPhone Duo pose — closed, open, folded like a book or in Split View — and unfolding reveals a new sidebar showing all lists for quick switching. Users can also open two Things windows side by side and drag and drop items between them, with controls in a vertical thumb-reach bar including the draggable Magic Plus button.
adaptation_zh: Things 3.25 会针对 iPhone Duo 的每种姿态重新排版——合上、展开、像书一样半折或分屏——展开后会出现一个新的侧边栏，列出所有清单以便快速切换。用户还可以并排打开两个 Things 窗口并在之间拖放任务，控件位于拇指可及的竖排栏中，包括可拖动的 Magic Plus 按钮。
highlights: Dynamic layout for all poses, in portrait and landscape
New sidebar for lists — a first for Things on iPhone
Multi-window side-by-side with drag-and-drop between windows (Things 3.25)
source_name: MacRumors: Things Updated for iPhone Duo With Adaptive Layout

adaptation_en: Tide Guide for iPhone Duo lets you check the tide at a glance, then unfold for a closer look at charts, weather and solunar details, with a new map putting real-time radar alongside your tide stations. It also adds a Solunar layout specifically designed for Duo for scrubbing through the monthly lunar phase.
adaptation_zh: Tide Guide 的 iPhone Duo 版本可先一瞥潮汐，再展开细看图表、天气和太阳月亮详情；新地图把实时雷达放在潮汐站旁边。还新增了专为 Duo 设计的 Solunar 布局，可拖动浏览整月的月相。
highlights: Tide charts and live weather radar in one view (Apple Newsroom)
New map: real-time radar alongside tide stations
Solunar layout specifically designed for Duo
source_name: Tide Guide: Charts & Tables — App Store, version 27.1.2

adaptation_en: Timepage 5.2.1 is built for iPhone Duo: closed, it is the familiar calendar, and open, the schedule unfolds with all-new vertical navigation for iPhone Duo and an interface that adapts to however the device is used.
adaptation_zh: Timepage 5.2.1 专为 iPhone Duo 打造：合上时是熟悉的日历，展开后日程随之铺开，配有全新的 Duo 竖向导航，界面会适应设备的使用方式。
highlights: All-new vertical navigation for iPhone Duo (v5.2.1)
Closed = familiar calendar; open = schedule unfolds
source_name: Timepage: Calendar Planner, App Store (Version 5.2.1 release notes)

adaptation_en: Tiny Computers is made for iPhone Duo: fold it into tabletop mode and it becomes a miniature retro computer, with the screen above and a working keyboard below. When closed, you can browse the collection and choose the next exhibit on the outer display.
adaptation_zh: Tiny Computers 专为 iPhone Duo 打造：将其折成桌面模式，即可变成一台微型复古电脑，上半部分是屏幕，下半部分是可用的键盘。合盖时可在外屏浏览藏品并选择下一个展品。
highlights: Tabletop mode: screen above, keyboard below
10 retro computers
Browse collection on closed outer display
source_name: Tiny Computers - App Store (US)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Toastie turns the phone itself into the toaster: fold it shut to close the lid and start toasting, then open it to check how your sandwich is doing. On the closed cover, the outer display acts as the lid with its indicator lamp, and opening partway lets you peek inside.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Toastie 让手机本身变成烤面包机：将手机折合即可盖上盖子开始烘烤，再打开即可查看三明治的状况。合盖时外屏充当带指示灯的盖子，半开则可以偷看里面的情况。
highlights: Fold shut to close the toaster lid
Cover display is lid with indicator lamp
Part-open peek inside
source_name: Toastie: grilled cheese game - App Store (US)

highlights: Featured in App Store 'Great Games on iPhone Duo' collection as 'Control Trains. Don't Crash!'
source_name: App Store: Great Games on iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: Tripsy added iPhone Duo support with adaptive layouts, toolbars, and navigation, and later improved Duo layouts and navigation for trip planning, calendars, notes, and activity details. Its developer blog describes an expanded layout giving itineraries and travel details more room when unfolded, with plans still accessible on the outer display when folded.
adaptation_zh: Tripsy 增加了对 iPhone Duo 的支持，采用自适应布局、工具栏和导航，并随后改进了 Duo 布局与导航，使行程规划、日历、笔记和活动详情更易使用。其开发者博客称，展开时扩展布局为行程和旅行详情留出更多空间，折叠时计划仍可在外屏查看。
highlights: Adaptive layouts, toolbars and navigation (v3.10.3)
Duo layout improvements for calendars, notes and activity details (v3.10.5)
source_name: Tripsy developer blog: Tripsy 3.10.3

adaptation_en: TypeDraw turns the iPhone Duo into a notebook: it looks like a notebook when the Duo is closed, and opening it reveals pages you can write on. Users can choose what happens when they open the book and personalise it with custom colours, fonts and their own handwriting.
adaptation_zh: TypeDraw 将 iPhone Duo 变成一本笔记本：Duo 合上时它看起来像一本笔记本，打开后即露出可书写的页面。用户可选择打开笔记本时显示什么，并用自定义颜色、字体和自己的手写字体进行个性化。
highlights: Notebook that opens when you unfold the phone
Choose what shows first on opening: a new note, latest note, or location-tied note
12 handwritten fonts; can turn your own handwriting into a font
source_name: MacRumors — The iPhone Duo Can Be a Tiny Mac, a Toaster, and a Nintendo DS (2026-10-23)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, United Airlines brings its navigation to the right side of the display, giving travelers quick access to booking flights, managing trips, and other tools throughout their journey.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，美联航将导航移至显示屏右侧，让旅客在旅途中快速访问订票、行程管理和其他工具。
highlights: Navigation moves to the right side of the display
Quick access to booking and trip management
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: VLLO gives video creators more editing controls and footage onscreen at once on the large inner display.
adaptation_zh: VLLO 在大尺寸内屏上让视频创作者同时看到更多编辑控件和素材画面。
highlights: More editing controls and footage onscreen at once
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Wakeout designed different interfaces for each Duo position — closed, open, tent mode or open like a laptop. Open like a book, the view splits across the hinge with movement game videos on the left; open like a laptop, videos shift to the vertical screen; closed, its navigation tabs become a slim side menu beside the camera.
adaptation_zh: Wakeout 为 Duo 的每种姿态设计了不同界面——合上、展开、帐篷式或笔记本式。像书一样打开时，界面跨铰链分屏，运动游戏视频在左侧；像笔记本一样打开时，视频移到竖立的屏幕；合上时，导航标签变成相机旁的纤细侧边菜单。
highlights: Different UI for closed, open, tent and laptop positions
Book pose: videos on the left across the hinge
Tent mode for propped-up desk viewing
source_name: TechCrunch — These clever apps show off the iPhone Duo's potential (2026-10-24)
Great Apps on iPhone Duo — App Store story (US)

adaptation_en: Weather360's version 3.1 release notes announce support for iPhone Duo, with a layout that unfolds along with the phone.
adaptation_zh: Weather360 3.1 版的更新说明宣布支持 iPhone Duo，布局会随手机展开而展开。
highlights: Version 3.1: iPhone Duo support announced in release notes
source_name: Weather360 - Forecast — App Store, version 3.1

highlights: App Store version 1.7.4 notes: 'Improved support for iPadOS 27 and iPhone Duo'
Apple Arcade title featured in App Store 'Great Games on iPhone Duo' collection as a cozy, magical life-sim
source_name: Wylde Flowers - App Store

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, Yelp puts maps and reviews side by side so users can discover and compare local businesses without tapping back and forth. Apple also described viewing local search results and business details side by side with the map.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Yelp 将地图和评论并排显示，用户无需来回点击即可发现和比较本地商家。Apple 还描述了将本地搜索结果和商家详情与地图并排查看。
highlights: Maps and reviews side by side
Search results and business details beside the map
Compare businesses at a glance
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (Oct 22, 2026)

adaptation_en: Zoom turns the inner display of iPhone Duo into an immersive video conference room, so users can see shared content and other participants at the same time.
adaptation_zh: Zoom 将 iPhone Duo 的内屏变成沉浸式视频会议室，用户可同时看到共享内容和其他参会者。
highlights: Shared content and participants visible simultaneously
Inner display as an immersive video conference room
source_name: Apple Newsroom: Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: In half-folded hover mode, the raised upper half plays the video while the flat lower half becomes a dedicated playback control panel — scrubbing, play/pause, quality selection, danmaku toggle, volume/brightness and screenshots — so controls never cover the picture. Apple also notes iQIYI gives more room to discover shows and films and adjusts its playback controls to each device position.
adaptation_zh: 半折悬停时，立起的上半屏播放视频，平置的下半屏变成独立播控中心，可拉进度、播放/暂停、选画质、开关弹幕、调音量/亮度及截屏，操作不遮挡画面。苹果官方亦称爱奇艺提供更多空间浏览节目和影片，并会根据设备姿态调整播放控制项。
highlights: Hover mode: video on top half, full control panel on bottom half
Demoed to Tim Cook at iQIYI's Beijing HQ on 2026-10-14; he praised the optimisation publicly
Named in Apple Newsroom's launch list of Duo-optimised China apps
source_name: PConline — 库克到访爱奇艺总部体验 iPhone Duo 适配 (2026-10-15)
爱范儿 ifanr — 首发｜我们用了一周的 iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)
App Store — Great Apps and Games on iPhone Duo (story collection)

highlights: App Store description states full support for iOS 27 and iPhone Duo
Version 5.12.2 notes: 'further improved the iPhone Duo experience'
source_name: App Store — TIDE: Sleep, Focus, Meditation (Moreless), version notes 5.12.1 / 5.12.2

adaptation_en: A build check of DeepSeek version 2.7.1 reports the app fills the inner display on iPhone Duo without letterboxing, and adapts when folding; the build uses the iOS 27.1 SDK and Apple's iPhone Duo APIs. No split or multi-column layout has been publicly described.
adaptation_zh: 对 DeepSeek 2.7.1 版安装包的检测显示，该应用在 iPhone Duo 上可铺满内屏、无黑边，并随折叠动作适配；其基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 并使用苹果 iPhone Duo API。目前尚无公开来源描述其分栏或多列布局。
highlights: Fills the inner display, not letterboxed (v2.7.1 build check)
source_name: Fits Duo — DeepSeek (citing App Store build 2.7.1)
DuoReady directory

adaptation_en: GeekPark's hands-on reports Feishu puts viewing and chatting together on the Duo: a video sent by a colleague can be watched on one part of the split screen while chatting on the other, with the interface adjusting to the hinge angle. In Lark Minutes (Miaojí) review, the meeting video sits on the left and the transcript and minutes on the right.
adaptation_zh: 据极客公园实测，飞书在 iPhone Duo 上把看和聊放到同一屏：同事发来的视频可分屏播放、一边看一边聊，界面还会随折叠角度调整；用妙记回看会议时，左边是会议视频，右边是文字记录和纪要。
highlights: Miaojí: meeting video on the left, transcript and minutes on the right
Video viewing and chat split on one screen, layout follows hinge angle
source_name: 极客公园 (GeekPark) via 新浪财经 — 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书

adaptation_en: Unfolded, Amap puts route options and travel time on the left with the full map on the right, and ride-hailing shows trip information on the left with the car's live position on the right. Amap also announced a split-screen navigation mode for Duo: lane-level guidance on the left half and a forward-looking map covering the next 3–5 km on the right.
adaptation_zh: 展开后，高德左侧显示路线方案和预计用时，右侧显示整张地图；打车时左侧是行程信息，右侧实时显示车辆位置。高德还宣布将推出针对 Duo 的分屏导航：左半屏为车道级导航，右半屏为可前瞻三到五公里的地图。
highlights: Route options left, full map right
Split navigation: lane-level guidance left, 3–5 km forward map right (announced)
Auto-adjusts layout on inner/outer screen switching and rotation
source_name: IT之家 via 新浪科技 — 高德官宣全面适配苹果iPhone Duo，全球首个分屏导航将上线 (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Goodnotes fills the inner display on iPhone Duo without letterboxing, according to a build check of version 7.1.32 (built with the iOS 27.1 SDK and using Apple's iPhone Duo APIs). The developer says the app is already optimized for the Duo, with more Duo-specific experiences still to come.
adaptation_zh: 据对 7.1.32 版安装包的检测，Goodnotes 在 iPhone Duo 上可铺满内屏、无黑边（基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 并使用苹果 iPhone Duo API）。开发者表示该应用已针对 Duo 优化，更多 Duo 专属体验还在开发中。
highlights: Fills the inner display, not letterboxed (v7.1.32 build check)
Developer: already optimized, more Duo-specific experiences to come
source_name: Fits Duo — Goodnotes (citing App Store build 7.1.32)
DuoReady directory
iPhone Duo Ready Apps (aggregator quoting App Store release notes v2.7.0)

adaptation_en: JD fills the inner display and adapts when the device is folded or unfolded; its current build (version 16.1.80) is built with the iOS 27.1 SDK and uses Apple's iPhone Duo APIs.
adaptation_zh: 京东可铺满内屏，并随折叠/展开状态自适应；当前版本（16.1.80）基于 iOS 27.1 SDK 构建，并使用了苹果的 iPhone Duo API。
highlights: Fills the inner display, no letterboxing
Built with iOS 27.1 SDK, uses Duo APIs (v16.1.80)
source_name: Fits Duo — Does 京东-又好又便宜 fit iPhone Duo? (App Store build check, v16.1.80, checked 2026-10-27)
DuoReady directory
DuoReady directory
爱范儿 ifanr — 首发｜我们用了一周的 iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Build analysis of Meitu 12.21.5 (2026-10-21) shows the app is built with the iOS 27.1 SDK and uses Apple's iPhone Duo APIs: it fills the full inner screen with no letterboxing and adapts when the device is folded or unfolded.
adaptation_zh: 对美图秀秀 12.21.5（2026-10-21）的安装包分析显示，该版本使用 iOS 27.1 SDK 构建并调用了苹果的 iPhone Duo API：展开后铺满整个内屏、无黑边，并会随折叠/展开状态调整。
highlights: Version 12.21.5 built with iOS 27.1 SDK, checked 2026-10-22
Uses Duo APIs including UIHingeInteraction and reserved-region handling
source_name: Fits Duo — Does Meitu fit iPhone Duo? (build check, version 12.21.5)

adaptation_en: When half-folded, NBA Peak Showdown (美职篮巅峰对决) puts the full game on the upper half of the display and the controls on the lower half, with player data shown directly in the control area so it can be checked without pausing or opening another page.
adaptation_zh: 半折时，美职篮巅峰对决上半屏显示完整的比赛画面，下半屏为操作区，球员数据直接显示在操作区里，无需暂停或另开页面查看。
highlights: Half-fold: game on top half, controls below
Player data shown in the lower control area, no pause needed
source_name: 极客公园 via 新浪科技 — 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书，发现作用不只是装「阔」 (2026-10-21)

adaptation_en: MD Vinyl (谜底黑胶) turns the library into a 3D record rack on the Duo: album sleeves spread apart or close up in response to the folding angle as the phone opens and closes. Half-folded on a desk it becomes a miniature turntable — the top half shows the album cover while the bottom half shows a spinning vinyl record and tonearm, and moving the tonearm onto or off the record starts or stops playback.
adaptation_zh: 谜底黑胶（MD Vinyl）在 iPhone Duo 上把音乐库变成 3D 唱片架：专辑封套会随折叠角度展开或收拢，手机开合时如翻阅唱片架。半折放在桌面时则变成迷你黑胶唱片机——上半屏展示专辑封套，下半屏是旋转中的唱片和唱臂，在虚拟唱盘上移动唱臂放下唱针即可播放，提起则停止。
highlights: 3D record rack responds to the hinge angle in real time
Half-folded seated mode mimics a turntable: cover above, vinyl and tonearm below
Supports Apple Music and Spotify libraries
source_name: unwire.hk — iPhone Duo 變黑膠唱片機 MD Vinyl 隨摺疊角度展開唱片架 (2026-10-26)

adaptation_en: MindNode's App Store update says it is ready for iPhone Duo: ideas can be captured on the compact outer screen, then the device unfolds to give thoughts more room. Its Side by Side feature shows the mind map and the outline simultaneously on the unfolded display, without switching between views.
adaptation_zh: MindNode 的 App Store 更新说明称其已为 iPhone Duo 做好准备：可在外屏小屏上捕捉想法，展开设备后获得更大的创作空间。其 Side by Side 功能可在展开的内屏上同时显示思维导图与大纲，无需在两种视图间切换。
highlights: Side by Side: mind map and outline shown simultaneously
Capture on the outer screen, unfold for a larger canvas
source_name: App Store — MindNode: Mind Map & Outline (update notes / event)

adaptation_en: Version 9.3.77 fixed the large black bars on the inner display.
adaptation_zh: 9.3.77 版已解决内屏大黑边
source_name: 什么值得买 — QQ回应iPhone Duo适配：已完成，升级9.3.77解决大黑边 (2026-10-22)
新浪科技/快科技 — 腾讯火速：QQ已经完成 iPhone Duo 适配 (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Apple says Sky Guide lets stargazers explore the night sky across the inner display of iPhone Duo, pairing edge-to-edge star maps with Liquid Glass controls. Its version 13.1 release notes add that the app expands as you unfold the display for a broader, more immersive view.
adaptation_zh: 苹果介绍称，Sky Guide 可在 iPhone Duo 内屏上探索夜空，星图以边到边方式铺满屏幕并搭配 Liquid Glass 控件。其 13.1 版更新说明亦称，应用会随展开屏幕而扩展，带来更广阔、沉浸的视野。
highlights: Edge-to-edge star maps across the inner display (per Apple)
v13.1 notes: expands as you unfold the display
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo

adaptation_en: In the developer's own write-up, the headline Duo feature is Seated Mode: half-fold the Duo during a workout and stand it on the floor or a table, and the workout splits across the two halves — the top half shows the exercise ring and what to do next, readable from across the room, while the bottom half shows a large timer, set count, and heart rate and energy at twice their normal size, with the close and pause buttons moved to the bottom of the flat half. The developer deliberately turned the vertical toolbar off in this app, finding the content misaligned with it.
adaptation_zh: 据开发者官方博文，Streaks Workout 最主要的 Duo 专属功能是 Seated Mode（坐立模式）：训练中将 Duo 半折立在地板或桌上，训练界面跨两半屏分工——上半屏显示运动圆环和下一步动作，远处也能看清；下半屏显示放大的计时器、组数，以及两倍大小的心率和能量数据，关闭/暂停按钮移到平置半屏底部。开发者还特意在本 App 中关闭了竖向工具栏，认为其内容与之对齐效果不佳。
highlights: Seated Mode splits the workout across both halves of the half-folded Duo
Heart rate and energy shown at twice normal size on the bottom half
Developer blog documents the update in detail (published 2026-10-20)
source_name: Crunchy Bagel (developer) — Updating Our Apps for iPhone Duo (2026-10-20)

adaptation_en: Unfolded, Taobao splits product pages into two panes — the main image on the left and the title, price and details on the right — and its messages page puts the merchant list on the left with the chat window on the right. Home and search results can be pinch-adjusted between two and four columns, and the cart shows full product titles and discount information.
adaptation_zh: 展开后，淘宝商品页分为左右两栏——主图在左，标题、价格和详情在右；消息页左侧是商家列表，右侧是聊天窗口。首页和搜索结果可双指捏合在两列到四列之间调整，购物车能显示完整的商品标题和优惠信息。
highlights: Product image left, title/price/details right
Messages: merchant list left, chat right
Pinch to switch home/search between 2 and 4 columns
source_name: 极客公园 via 新浪科技 — 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书 (2026-10-21)

adaptation_en: Tencent Video adapted every page for the Duo's closed-portrait and unfolded-landscape forms: unfolded, it goes straight into a full-screen player that fills the display, and the bottom tab bar moves to a side vertical bar. In Laptop Mode the top half plays the programme while the bottom half carries streamlined playback controls (with enlarged core buttons and danmaku input that does not cover the video); Tent Mode supports full-screen landscape playback, and the unfolded app can run in Split View alongside a third-party app.
adaptation_zh: 腾讯视频针对「闭合竖屏 + 展开横屏」双形态完成各功能页面布局适配：展开后可直接进入铺满屏幕的全屏播放器，底部导航改为侧边竖向导航栏（Vertical bar）。笔记本模式下上半屏播放正片、下半屏承载精简播控（核心按键放大，可在不遮挡画面的情况下输入弹幕）；帐篷模式支持全屏横屏播放；展开状态下还可与第三方 App 分屏同开。
highlights: First-batch 'full-scenario' Duo adaptation, live on the App Store from 2026-10-21
Only video-entertainment app invited to Apple's 2026-10-21 iPhone Duo app showcase
Laptop Mode and Tent Mode each given dedicated player layouts
source_name: 品玩 PingWest — 腾讯视频首批全场景适配 iPhone Duo 现已重磅上线 (2026-10-23)

adaptation_en: On iPhone Duo, the Tesla app (version 4.62.x) uses a two-column layout: navigation and controls — Controls, Climate, Location, Charging, Security and more — in the left column, with a large 3D view of the car or home on the right. Folded, it returns to the regular phone layout; the Powerwall energy view likewise shows live power flow on the larger screen.
adaptation_zh: 在 iPhone Duo 上，Tesla App（4.62.x 版）采用双栏布局：左侧为导航与控制项——控制、空调、位置、充电、安全等，右侧为车辆或住宅的大幅 3D 视图。合上后恢复常规手机布局；Powerwall 能源视图同样在大屏上显示实时能量流。
highlights: Two columns: controls/menu left, large 3D car or home view right
Announced by Tesla designer Alex Guichet, 2026-10-21 (v4.62.0)
Returns to phone layout when folded
source_name: MacRumors — Tesla App Gains iPad and iPhone Duo Support (2026-10-22)
DuoReady directory

adaptation_en: Apple states Weibo optimises its feeds, videos and posting tools for iPhone Duo, with layouts for reading, watching and sharing when unfolded or partially folded. Chinese press reports add that version 16.10.2 (pushed 2026-10-21) redesigned the post body, video playback and the hot-search list specifically for the 7.6-inch inner screen.
adaptation_zh: 苹果官方称，微博针对 iPhone Duo 优化了信息流、视频和发帖工具，并为展开和半折叠两种状态下的阅读、观看与分享准备了相应布局。国内报道称，微博于 2026 年 10 月 21 日推送 16.10.2 版本，针对 7.6 英寸内屏重新设计了微博正文、视频播放和发现热搜榜。
highlights: Version 16.10.2 shipped 2026-10-21, before the Duo's 2026-10-23 launch
Reported as the first social app to complete its Duo adaptation
Named in Apple Newsroom's launch list of Duo-optimised China apps
source_name: Apple Newsroom — Developers bring incredible new app experiences to iPhone Duo (2026-10)
DuoReady directory

adaptation_en: Kingsoft's WPS for iPhone Duo adds Resizing adaptation so the home layout auto-adjusts across inner screen, outer screen, landscape, portrait and any hinge position, with spreadsheets showing more rows and columns when expanded. In split-screen mode two documents from the same app open side by side for comparison, with text and images draggable between them, and a companion AI sidebar sits beside the document on the large screen instead of covering it.
adaptation_zh: 金山办公的 WPS for iPhone Duo 加入 Resizing 自适应能力，首页布局可在内屏、外屏、横竖屏及任意铰链形态下自动适配，展开后表格可同屏显示更多行列。分屏模式下可同应用双开两份文档并排对照，文字、图片可长按拖拽互传；大屏上文档与伴随式 AI 侧栏同屏协作，侧栏不再遮挡正文。
highlights: Split-screen dual-document opening with drag-and-drop between documents
Companion AI sidebar beside the document on the expanded screen
Resizing adaptation across inner/outer screens and any hinge position
source_name: 中华网 — 金山办公上线 WPS for iPhone Duo 适配折叠屏新体验 (Kingsoft Office announcement, 2026-10-25)

adaptation_en: Hands-on testing found that on the unfolded inner screen a note opens split left/right — images on the left, body text and comments on the right — while the home feed shows more notes per screen than the two-column outer-screen feed, and the function menu moves to the bottom-right. For video notes, playback continues on the outer screen when the phone is closed, and when propped half-folded on a desk the video sits on the top half with comments below, so interacting does not cover the picture.
adaptation_zh: 实测显示，展开内屏后打开笔记为左右分栏——左边看图，右边看正文和评论；首页一屏可显示更多笔记（外屏仍为双列），功能菜单移到屏幕右侧底部。视频笔记合上手机后会在外屏续播；微折立在桌上时视频在上、评论在下，互动不遮挡画面。
highlights: Note view: images left, text and comments right on the inner screen
Video notes continue playing on the outer screen when folded shut
Half-folded desk mode: video on top, comments below
source_name: 极客公园 GeekPark via 新浪科技 — 我用 iPhone Duo 刷小红书、淘宝、飞书 (2026-10-21)
爱范儿 ifanr — 首发｜我们用了一周的 iPhone Duo (2026-10-22)

adaptation_en: Bear fills the inner display on iPhone Duo with a panel layout and no letterboxing, per a build check of version 3.0.3. Apple, which named Bear as adapted, says tasks and notes are simpler to organise with more on screen at once.
adaptation_zh: 据对 3.0.3 版安装包的检测，熊掌记 Bear 在 iPhone Duo 上以分栏面板布局铺满内屏、无黑边。苹果将其列为已适配应用，并称一屏可显示更多内容，任务与笔记更易整理。
highlights: Panel layout filling the full inner display
Named by Apple as adapted; more notes and tasks on screen at once
source_name: Fits Duo — Bear (citing Apple Newsroom and App Store build 3.0.3)

adaptation_en: Apple's launch roundup of Duo-optimised China apps states that Xmind shows mind maps and outlines side by side on iPhone Duo. A build check also reports Xmind fills the inner display without letterboxing.
adaptation_zh: 苹果发布时汇总的中国区 Duo 适配应用介绍称，Xmind 在 iPhone Duo 上可将思维导图与大纲并排显示。安装包检测亦显示其可铺满内屏、无黑边。
highlights: Mind maps and outlines side by side (per Apple)
Fills the inner display, not letterboxed
source_name: FoneArena — Apple details apps and games optimised for iPhone Duo (reproducing Apple Newsroom table)

adaptation_en: Alipay version 12.12.38 (2026-10-21) adapts the app for the iPhone Duo foldable, with its release notes citing a further-optimised large-screen experience; the build fills the inner display.
adaptation_zh: 支付宝 12.12.38 版（2026-10-21）适配了 iPhone Duo 折叠屏，更新日志称大屏体验进一步优化；该版本可铺满内屏显示。
highlights: Version 12.12.38 release notes cite iPhone Duo adaptation
Large-screen experience further optimised
source_name: IT之家 via 蓝鸢梦想 — 支付宝 iOS 端推 12.12.38 版本更新，适配 iPhone Duo (2026-10-21)

adaptation_en: Version 8.0.80 (released 2026-10-23, launch day) brought WeChat's first real Duo layout: unfolded, the conversation list sits on the left and the chat detail on the right in two panes; half-folded, the chat stays on the top half and the input area on the bottom half, avoiding the crease. Still transitional: built on the older SDK tier, a black bar remains along the right side, and there is no tablet mode yet — the Duo is still recognized as a regular phone. Tencent says optimization will continue.
adaptation_zh: 8.0.80 版（2026-10-23 首发日推送）带来微信在 Duo 上的首个真分栏布局：展开后左侧会话列表、右侧聊天详情；半折时上半屏聊天、下半屏输入，并避让折痕。仍属过渡适配：基于旧 SDK 档位，右侧仍有黑边，且暂无平板模式——Duo 仍被识别为普通手机。腾讯表示后续会持续优化。
highlights: First inner-screen adaptation in iOS 8.0.80 (released 2026-10-23)
Two-pane chat when unfolded; half-fold puts chat on top, input below the crease
No tablet mode yet — the Duo is still recognized as a phone
source_name: 新浪新闻 — 微信紧急适配iPhone Duo：分栏来了，黑边还在 (2026-10-23)

adaptation_en: Version 1.5 adds a hinge-aware iPhone Duo layout: unfolded in landscape, the live animated power-flow dial stays pinned on the left half — across the Dashboard, Cars, Devices and Automation tabs — while energy charts and other sections scroll on the right half, with the divider sitting on the hinge; folding or unfolding keeps your scroll position, and when folded the tab bar moves into a bar along the edge of the cover screen.
adaptation_zh: 1.5 版新增针对 iPhone Duo 铰链优化的布局：横向展开时，实时动态功率流表盘固定在左半屏——在仪表盘、车辆、设备与自动化标签页中均保持不变——能源图表等其他内容在右半屏滚动，分隔线正落在铰链处；折叠或展开时保持当前滚动位置，合上后标签栏移至外屏边缘的侧栏。
highlights: App Store product page carries a 'Made for iPhone Duo' badge
Third-party Tesla Powerwall / solar / vehicle dashboard by EnergyPlay Software LLC
Live power-flow dial pinned on the left half, divider on the hinge
Energy charts and other sections scroll on the right half
Dial stays in place across Cars, Devices and Automation tabs
Cover-screen tab bar along the screen edge when folded
Fold/unfold preserves scroll position
source_name: SolDial blog - Your Powerwall, Unfolded: SolDial on iPhone Duo and Android Foldables

adaptation_en: Added large-screen adaptation for iPhone Duo, including split view.
adaptation_zh: 新增 iPhone Duo 大屏适配 + 分屏
highlights: Now displays properly / fills the Duo's wider inner screen
Can be used alongside other apps in Split View
source_name: MacRumors - Apple Support App Updated for iPhone Duo's Larger Display

adaptation_en: Added iPhone Duo UI support.
adaptation_zh: 新增 iPhone Duo UI 支持
highlights: UI support for iPhone Duo in Sonos 27.2 / iOS app 90.1
source_name: Sonos Support - Release notes: Sonos app updates

adaptation_en: The 2.31.0 release notes explicitly cite 'iPhone Duo Support' with improved compatibility for foldable devices; the new version now fills the inner display (previously letterboxed with black bars).
adaptation_zh: 2.31.0 版更新说明明确写「iPhone Duo Support」，提升折叠设备兼容性，新版已铺满内屏（此前为黑边居中 Letterboxed）
highlights: 2.31.0 release notes explicitly cite 'iPhone Duo Support'
Now fills the inner display; previous version 2.30.0 was letterboxed
source_name: Fits Duo - Does VibeShort fit iPhone Duo?

adaptation_en: The 7.9.0 release notes explicitly cite 'Improved support for iPhone Duo', plus optimized Home card height on large screens.
adaptation_zh: 7.9.0 版更新说明明确写「Improved support for iPhone Duo」，另优化了大屏 Home 卡片高度
highlights: 7.9.0 release notes explicitly cite 'Improved support for iPhone Duo'
Now fills the inner display; previous version 7.8.0 only partly fit
source_name: Fits Duo - Does Gospel Library fit iPhone Duo?

adaptation_en: Version 1.4 adds native iPhone Duo support: Workbench runs natively on the Duo, with support for keeping an AI agent visible in one pane while using the rest of the phone. The same release adds a built-in remote terminal that can be switched to without reconnecting.
adaptation_zh: 1.4 版新增 iPhone Duo 原生支持：可在一个分栏里留住 AI agent，同时使用手机其余部分；同版还新增可免重连切换的内置远程终端
highlights: 1.4 release notes explicitly cite native iPhone Duo support
Agent can stay visible in one pane while using the rest of the phone
Remote desktop app for Mac by Astro HQ LLC; free + subscription
source_name: 9to5Mac - Astropad Workbench 1.4 adds terminal access, iPhone Duo support, and more

adaptation_en: Version 1.30.0 (2026-10-27) release notes state the app can follow iPhone Duo folds and Split View; the App Store release notes cite 'Support for iPhone Duo and iPad multitasking windows'. OpenDisplay turns an iPhone or iPad into a second monitor for a Mac and is free and open source.
adaptation_zh: 1.30.0 版（2026-10-27）发布说明称可跟随 iPhone Duo 折叠与 Split View；App Store 更新说明写「Support for iPhone Duo and iPad multitasking windows」。OpenDisplay 可把 iPhone/iPad 变为 Mac 的第二台显示器，免费开源
highlights: 1.30.0 release notes: 'follow iPhone Duo folds and Split View'
App Store release notes cite iPhone Duo support (per 2026-10-28 DuoReady watch)
Free and open source, by Philip Poloczek
source_name: OpenDisplay v1.30.0 release notes (GitHub release, mirrored at Software Mirrors)

adaptation_en: Version 1.1 is made for iPhone Duo and uses the full display open, closed or half-folded: it reads the fold and the camera and lays the editor out around them. Open in book mode, the photo sits on one half and the editing panel on the other, split right at the fold; in laptop mode the photo stands on top with sliders below the fold, and unfolding mid-edit keeps the same tool and slider in hand.
adaptation_zh: 1.1 版专为 iPhone Duo 打造，展开、合上或半折时均使用完整屏幕：读取折痕与相机位置并绕开它们排布编辑器。Book 模式下照片在一侧、编辑面板在另一侧，正好按折痕分栏；Laptop 模式下照片在上、滑杆在折痕下方；编辑中展开也保持同一工具与滑杆位置
highlights: 1.1.0 App Store release notes: 'iPhone Duo support: masoc now uses the full display, open, closed or half-folded'
Developer site documents book and laptop layouts split at the fold
Photo on one side, panel on the other when open
source_name: masoc developer site - iPhone Duo Photo Editor With Film Halation (masoc 1.1)

adaptation_en: As of late October 2026, hands-on tests of top Chinese apps on iPhone Duo (including a 25-app test by creator He Tongxue, reported via Sina) list Douyin as NOT yet adapted: unfolded, it runs as a centered phone-ratio window on the 7.6-inch inner screen with large black bars on both sides. No split-pane or large-screen layout, and split-screen multitasking is unavailable. Apple will require Duo screenshots for app updates from April 2027, so adaptation is widely expected to be a matter of time.
adaptation_zh: 截至 2026 年 10 月底，多项实测（包括何同学对 25 款常用 App 的测试，经新浪报道）均将抖音列为尚未适配 iPhone Duo：展开后以手机比例居中显示在 7.6 英寸内屏上，两侧留有大面积黑边；没有分栏或大屏布局，也无法使用分屏多任务。苹果要求自 2027 年 4 月起应用更新必须包含 Duo 截图，适配预计只是时间问题。
highlights: Hands-on tested on iPhone Duo: letterboxed phone window, black bars on both sides
No split-pane layout or split-screen multitasking yet
source_name: 新浪新闻 — iPhone Duo 首发实测翻车？近八成 App 未适配（何同学 25 款 App 测试）

adaptation_en: Version 2.11.0 (2026-10-27) release notes state: 'AntiqSnap is now optimized for iPhone Duo, with interface improvements for a smoother experience.' The previous version ran letterboxed on the Duo inner screen; the new version fills it.
adaptation_zh: 2.11.0 版（2026-10-27）更新说明写：「AntiqSnap is now optimized for iPhone Duo, with interface improvements for a smoother experience（现已针对 iPhone Duo 优化，界面改进、体验更流畅）」。此前版本在 Duo 内屏为黑边居中显示，新版已铺满内屏。
highlights: 2.11.0 App Store release notes: 'now optimized for iPhone Duo'
Previously letterboxed on the inner screen (per 2026-10-29 DuoReady watch)
Free with in-app purchases, by Next Vision Limited
source_name: App Store release notes (2.11.0, 2026-10-27)

adaptation_en: Version 27.0.0 (2026-10-28) release notes state: 'Tips & Tricks also now fully supports the new iPhone Duo.' No specific layout detail is published. This is the paid Pro app ($2.99, by Intelligenti Ltd), distinct from the free Tips & Tricks already listed on the site.
adaptation_zh: 27.0.0 版（2026-10-28）更新说明写：「Tips & Tricks also now fully supports the new iPhone Duo（现已全面支持 iPhone Duo）」，未公布具体布局细节。这是付费版 Pro（2.99 美元，Intelligenti Ltd），与站上已收录的免费版 Tips & Tricks 是不同的 App。
highlights: 27.0.0 App Store release notes: 'now fully supports the new iPhone Duo'
Paid Pro version ($2.99), distinct from the free Tips & Tricks on site
source_name: App Store release notes (27.0.0, 2026-10-28)

adaptation_en: Version 8.2.40 (2026-10-28) release notes state for the first time: 'Optimized for iPhone Duo: Unfold more room for your plans.' Earlier builds already filled the inner screen, but this is the first version whose release notes explicitly claim Duo optimization; no specific two-pane layout is described.
adaptation_zh: 8.2.40 版（2026-10-28）更新说明首次明确写：「Optimized for iPhone Duo: Unfold more room for your plans（已针对 iPhone Duo 优化：展开获得更多规划空间）」。早期构建已能铺满内屏，但这是更新说明首次明确声称 Duo 优化；未描述具体的双栏布局。
highlights: 8.2.40 App Store release notes: 'Optimized for iPhone Duo: Unfold more room for your plans'
To-do list and calendar app by Appest Limited, free with in-app purchases
